notes.title: Mannequin The Spotting Out Now!
notes.content:
[b]The sequel to Mannequin the Passing is out now!
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41912905/da045d67e668fbc1cbb7e030720872f21be422c0.png[/img]

The Mannequins have returned, but this time, things are a little different. Each stage will commence in the safety of a security office, where you will gain access to the cameras in every room, revealing the presence of the eerie Mannequins. As you switch between cameras, the evil Mannequins will subtly change their pose. You can mark the Mannequins by clicking on them. Once you have completed marking, or run out of time, you will venture into the rooms alongside them. Any Mannequins you have previously marked will remain identified, enabling you to navigate through them and find your way to the exit.

[previewyoutube=9jHU5usECEs;full][/previewyoutube]

However, this is just one of the seven gameplay modes available. This time I have introduced different gameplay modes to keep your adventure even more interesting.

[h2]Modes:[/h2]
[list]

[*][b]Spotting: [/b]
Observe the Mannequins as they change their poses.
[*][b]Path: [/b]
Observe the Mannequins' changing poses and draw your path to the exit while everything plunges into darkness.
[*][b]Lights: [/b]
Observe Mannequins change their poses, and beware of the additional Mannequins. Turning on lights above them will stop them from hurting you.
[*][b]Shadows: [/b]
Watch out for the Mannequins' mismatched shadows.
[*][b]Placement: [/b]
The rules are flipped in this mode. The good Mannequins will be positioned differently based on the camera that your viewing, while the Evil ones remain stationary.
[*][b]Looking: [/b]
If a Mannequin spots the Evil one, it will be looking at it.
[*][b]?: [/b]
An unlockable mode, following in the footsteps of Mannequin: The Passing.[/list]
Each stage is referred to as a contract, and between contracts, you will have access to a secure apartment where you can unwind, kick a ball, and continue your story. Hidden Gems have returned which can be used to change the Mannequins' appearances. Additionally, there is a Free Play mode where you can select your preferred stage, mode, and difficulty. With a total of 20 different stages and 10 different themes, the possibilities for your experience are vast.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41912905/a49393f0c4ae7bafe3e211d8b63aca5ea039a640.png[/img]

Taking into account your invaluable feedback from the first game, I have been focused on enhancing the sequel from its inception. This includes the Story of the game being made from the beginning, guided by two voices throughout the game. I have also made modifications to the difficulty levels. In Mannequin The Passing, playing on Very Easy was still very challenging to new players. Therefore, this time, the clues are much more noticeable, greatly assisting with the game's difficulty. 

I want to express my sincere gratitude to everyone who played the first game, regardless of whether you liked it or not, and whether you provided feedback or not. 

Mannequin: The Spotting will be released later this year. Don't forget to add it to your wishlist to stay updated on all the latest news and updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451140/Mannequin_The_Spotting/

notes.title: Mannequin The Spotting Release Date
notes.content:
Mannequin The Spotting has now got a release date, it is releasing on the 30th of July, (US Pacific Time).

To coincide with this announcement, there is a new, brief gameplay trailer on the main modes of play. 

[previewyoutube=2lsZuFuVs0A;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for following, Mannequin The Spotting!

-Andy
